title: My voiceprint
loginRequired: Sign in to manage your voiceprint.
intro: Register only your own voice. Permissions and voiceprints are managed separately for your personal account and each organization.
disabled: Voiceprints are currently unavailable in this scope. You can still revoke permissions or delete an existing profile.
organizationPolicyHint: This only makes the feature available. Each person must grant their own permissions.

allow_enrollment.title: Allow me to register and confirm my voice
allow_enrollment.hint: Registration is voluntary. Turning this off revokes this scope's voiceprint and stops outstanding registration tasks.

allow_accumulation.title: Allow sampling of my microphone in calls
allow_accumulation.hint: Separate permission for collecting candidate clips from my account's microphone. Sampling must be visible and can be paused; it does not confirm a template.

allow_identification.title: Allow matching against my voiceprint
allow_identification.hint: Separate permission to offer my identity as a suggestion within an allowed candidate group. Turning this off stops new matches; it does not change names already confirmed by people.

enrollmentHint: Read the displayed prompt alone in a quiet place. Aim for four clips of about eight seconds, with at least 30 seconds in total. No more than six clips per session; each clip must be 3–10 seconds.

recording.idle: Recording starts only when you choose Record.
recording.preparing: Microphone stopped. Preparing your clip for playback…

file: Or choose my recorded WAV clip
fileHint: Your own recording of this prompt only: mono, PCM16, 24 kHz, 3–10 seconds. Already uploaded clips remain available for review or profile deletion.

updateReason.expired: The voiceprint is over a year old. Register fresh samples.
updateReason.model_changed: The voice model has changed. Register again.
updateReason.contributions_changed: The original samples or template are no longer valid. Register fresh samples.
updateReason.storage_unavailable: The private voiceprint cannot be read. Contact your administrator.

statusUnavailable: This server does not provide verified voiceprint status. Update it and reload.
noProfile: No voiceprint registered in this scope.
deleteConfirmation: Delete your voiceprint in “{{scope}}”? This immediately revokes its use, stops pending tasks and queues cleanup of samples and templates. Other scopes and existing meeting names are unaffected.
qualityHint: Encoding alone cannot establish that a clip contains one person speaking. Confirmation is unavailable until speech and speaker quality checks pass.
listenHint: Listen to the whole clip and confirm it is your voice before accepting it.

deletionStatus.failed: Voiceprint remains revoked; cleanup failed. Contact your administrator.

errors.failed: The operation failed. Try again or reload the current settings.
errors.unavailable: The account, scope or authorization is no longer available. Reload before continuing.
errors.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before making another change.
errors.microphone: The microphone could not be used. Check browser permissions, or choose your own WAV recording.
errors.voiceprint_enrollment_quota: The registration limit has been reached. Try again after the 24-hour quota window.
errors.voiceprint_duplicate_audio: This recording is already registered. Record a different clip.
errors.voiceprint_audio_format_invalid: Use a mono PCM16 WAV at 24 kHz.
errors.voiceprint_quality_pending: This clip is awaiting quality review.
errors.voiceprint_upload_expired: Upload permission expired. Start a new registration session.
errors.voiceprint_key_unavailable: Voiceprint storage is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

call.title: Voiceprint sampling in this call
call.notice: Only your authorized individual microphone is used to create or improve your voiceprint. Limits: {{clip}} seconds per clip, {{session}} seconds per session and {{daily}} seconds per rolling 24 hours. Unconfirmed audio is kept for at most {{hours}} hours; after confirmation and feature extraction, audio is removed promptly. Delete samples and your voiceprint for this scope in voiceprint settings.
call.confirmation: A clip may contain other people's voices. Listen and confirm your own clips before they enter the voiceprint library. Voiceprint sampling and full-call recording require separate authorization.
call.declaration: Declare the device you actually use. Saving a device or changing sharing pauses sampling; allowing this call requires a separate action.
call.remaining: Remaining: {{session}} seconds in this session, {{daily}} seconds per rolling 24 hours
call.mixedSpeaker: More than one voice was detected, so sampling is paused. Check that only you use this microphone and review your clips before allowing sampling again.

reason.ready: The device is declared; current activity is reported separately.
reason.disabled: Call sampling is disabled in this scope.
reason.authorization_required: Authorize future call sampling separately in voiceprint settings.
reason.paused: Sampling in this call is paused.
reason.shared_microphone: Shared microphones are excluded by default. Confirm that only you use it before changing this setting.
reason.device_required: Declare the device used in this call.
reason.microphone_unavailable: No eligible personal microphone is available.
reason.quota_exhausted: The session or rolling 24-hour sampling limit was reached.
reason.sampling_dispatch_unavailable: The sampling service is unavailable; recovery will be attempted.

error.unavailable: Sampling status cannot be confirmed. Reload to try again.
error.conflict: The declaration or authorization changed. Reload before deciding again.
error.authentication_changed: Your login changed. Rejoin with your current account.
error.connection_pending: Waiting for the current call connection to synchronize.
